description: Print resolution, bleed and uncompressed bitmap size arithmetic — Given an image's pixel size and a print size (inches, millimetres or centimetres) plus optional bleed, margin and target ppi, returns the effective ppi over trim plus bleed, whether it meets the target, the pixel count a target ppi needs, the largest print size a target ppi allows, the safe area, and the exact uncompressed bitmap size. Built for print-on-demand, layout and image-prep agents; the t

bleed.description: Bleed added on each side of the trim, in unit (default 0).

channels.description: Channels per pixel for the raw size (default 3).

claimedEffectivePpi.description: An effective ppi you assert; checked against the computed value.

claimedRawBytes.description: An uncompressed byte count you assert.

margin.description: Safe margin inside the trim on each side, in unit (default 0).

targetPpi.description: The resolution you require, in pixels per inch.

unit.description: Unit for print size, bleed and margin (default in).

name: print-estimate
